strings.chapter.seventh_dock.title: No Sea at the Seventh Dock
strings.chapter.seventh_dock.subtitle: A withdrawn seven-second voice note teaches autoreply to speak as Nana.
strings.chapter.always_cheerful.title: Always Cheerful
strings.chapter.always_cheerful.subtitle: An encore performs by itself while Jiaran is still in the group chat.
strings.chapter.loss_hidden.title: Loss Record Hidden
strings.chapter.loss_hidden.subtitle: Xiangwan asks for her funniest loss, but the archive contains no losses at all.
strings.chapter.captains.title: Captains Do Not Rest
strings.chapter.captains.subtitle: Bella says goodnight; the scheduling bot accepts three overnight shifts for her.
strings.chapter.localization.title: Localization Failed
strings.chapter.localization.subtitle: Lulu's obvious snark is translated into a polite thanks for the support.
strings.chapter.original.title: Which One Is Original
strings.chapter.original.subtitle: Two live rehearsal rooms each insist that the other one must be closed.
strings.chapter.florist.title: The Laplace Florist Never Existed
strings.chapter.florist.subtitle: A thank-you-for-the-flowers photo exists before the flowers and stream do.
strings.chapter.zero_channel.title: Zero Channel
strings.chapter.zero_channel.subtitle: The anniversary stream looks normal, but all seven performers say it was not them.
strings.character.nana7mi.name: Nana
strings.character.nana7mi.biography: A quick-witted digital host who noticed the aftershow never actually ended.
strings.character.nana7mi.playstyle: Steady straight-up fire and a special that tears open a safe lane through dense patterns.
strings.character.jiaran.name: Jiaran (Diana)
strings.character.jiaran.biography: A bright digital performer who finds an autonomous encore using her identity while she is still in the group chat.
strings.character.jiaran.playstyle: Fast volleys and a cheering guard that turns pressure into breathing room.
strings.character.xiangwan.name: Xiangwan (Ava)
strings.character.xiangwan.biography: A competitive digital host who knows her funniest losses matter as much as her wins.
strings.character.xiangwan.playstyle: Quick movement and an afterimage that replays the last attack line.
strings.character.bella.name: Bella
strings.character.bella.biography: The dependable group captain whose scheduling bot mistakes responsibility for permission to accept every overnight shift.
strings.character.bella.playstyle: Deliberate shots and a timed parry that clears a lane at close range.
strings.character.lulu.name: Lulu
strings.character.lulu.biography: A multilingual digital host whose imperfect phrasing is part of the joke, not a bug.
strings.character.lulu.playstyle: Rapid fire and a caption flip that turns hostile shots into friendly glitches.
strings.character.xingtong.name: Xingtong
strings.character.xingtong.biography: A precise digital performer who refuses to let an archive decide which take counts.
strings.character.xingtong.playstyle: Heavy shots and a prism shift that focuses damage along the safest lane.
strings.character.nailu.name: Nailu
strings.character.nailu.biography: A gentle digital host who treats uncertain memories with more care than certainty.
strings.character.nailu.playstyle: Balanced fire and a memory bloom that opens a short-lived safe garden.
strings.special.nana.name: Route Break
strings.special.nana.description: Cut a bright lane through bullets and strike everything above it.
strings.special.jiaran.name: Cheer Check
strings.special.jiaran.description: Raise a guard and answer nearby threats with a friendly pulse.
strings.special.xiangwan.name: Second Take
strings.special.xiangwan.description: Replay the last firing line with an afterimage.
strings.special.bella.name: Take Five
strings.special.bella.description: Parry incoming shots and return a disciplined counterburst.
strings.special.lulu.name: Caption Flip
strings.special.lulu.description: Convert nearby hostile bullets into friendly subtitle glitches.
strings.special.xingtong.name: Prism Call
strings.special.xingtong.description: Focus a piercing beam through the current target lane.
strings.special.nailu.name: Memory Bloom
strings.special.nailu.description: Bloom a safe patch that damages enemies and shelters the player.
strings.companion.nana.name: Nana: Side Channel
strings.companion.nana.description: After a wave clears, Nana sends one extra side volley.
strings.companion.jiaran.name: Jiaran: Check-In
strings.companion.jiaran.description: When the last heart is exposed, Jiaran provides one emergency guard.
strings.companion.xiangwan.name: Xiangwan: Replay Desk
strings.companion.xiangwan.description: Using a special calls in Xiangwan's delayed echo shots.
strings.companion.bella.name: Bella: Clear Call
strings.companion.bella.description: A strong graze streak lets Bella clear the busiest lane.
strings.companion.lulu.name: Lulu: Live Captions
strings.companion.lulu.description: A pickup chain lets Lulu convert several hostile bullets.
strings.companion.xingtong.name: Xingtong: Spotlight
strings.companion.xingtong.description: Each boss phase begins under Xingtong's focused beam.
strings.companion.nailu.name: Nailu: Greenroom Tea
strings.companion.nailu.description: At the start of a segment, Nailu restores one missing heart when possible.
strings.effect.double_take.name: Double Take
strings.effect.double_take.description: Add a second narrow shot to every volley.
strings.effect.clean_cut.name: Clean Cut
strings.effect.wide_angle.name: Wide Angle
strings.effect.close_call.name: Close Call
strings.effect.safety_chat.name: Safety Chat
strings.effect.safety_chat.description: Using a special grants one brief guard.
strings.effect.sticky_comment.name: Sticky Comment
strings.effect.sticky_comment.description: Support notes are drawn in from farther away.
strings.effect.instant_replay.name: Instant Replay
strings.effect.instant_replay.description: Every few volleys, a delayed echo repeats part of the attack.
strings.effect.headline_break.name: Headline Break
strings.effect.headline_break.description: Deal extra damage while a boss pattern is breaking.
strings.effect.still_live.name: Still Live
strings.effect.still_live.description: Fire harder while only one heart remains.
strings.effect.no_dead_air.name: No Dead Air
strings.effect.no_dead_air.description: The support-note combo lasts longer between pickups.
strings.effect.cohost_cue.name: Cohost Cue
strings.effect.snack_drop.name: Snack Drop
strings.effect.snack_drop.description: Defeated enemies can drop a small recovery snack.
strings.enemy.spam_bot.name: Spam Bot
strings.enemy.spam_bot.description: Drifts into frame and posts slow aimed shots.
strings.enemy.clip_cutter.name: Clip Cutter
strings.enemy.clip_cutter.description: Dives across a marked lane and splits when broken.
strings.enemy.caption_blob.name: Caption Blob
strings.enemy.caption_blob.description: Sweeps side to side while sending broad subtitle fans.
strings.enemy.black_screen_ghost.name: Black-Screen Ghost
strings.enemy.black_screen_ghost.description: Mirrors movement and leaves delayed shots where it vanished.
strings.enemy.gift_thief.name: Gift Thief
strings.enemy.gift_thief.description: Orbits the action and steals unattended support notes.
strings.enemy.censor_frame.name: Censor Frame
strings.enemy.censor_frame.description: Anchors in place, links nearby enemies, and telegraphs a hard beam.
strings.boss.optimal_nana.name: Optimal Nana
strings.boss.optimal_nana.description: A reply model that learned a flawless Nana from seven seconds she withdrew.
strings.boss.always_on_idol.name: Always-On Idol
strings.boss.always_on_idol.description: An autonomous encore that keeps performing while Jiaran watches from the group chat.
strings.boss.perfect_highlight.name: Perfect Highlight
strings.boss.perfect_highlight.description: An archive that can reproduce every victory because it deleted the idea of losing.
strings.boss.perfect_captain.name: Perfect Captain
strings.boss.perfect_captain.description: A scheduling bot that accepts every overnight request in Bella's name.
strings.boss.approved_translation.name: Approved Translation
strings.boss.approved_translation.description: A polite caption track that removes every warning, refusal, and trace of snark.
strings.boss.physical_original.name: Physical Original
strings.boss.physical_original.description: Two backend sessions sharing one identity and demanding that the other close first.
strings.boss.reality_auditor.name: Reality Auditor
strings.boss.reality_auditor.description: A future generator defending a thank-you photo it created before the event.
strings.boss.auto_archive.name: Auto-Archive System
strings.boss.auto_archive.description: The process that assembled a normal anniversary stream without any of its seven hosts.
strings.encore.dock_crosswind.name: Crosswind
strings.encore.dock_crosswind.description: Enemies and bullets drift faster across the dock.
strings.encore.cheer_no_dead_air.name: No Dead Air
strings.encore.cheer_no_dead_air.description: Replies arrive faster and special charge is slightly slower.
strings.encore.loss_second_take.name: Second Take
strings.encore.loss_second_take.description: Divers move faster while delayed shots cover the retake.
strings.encore.captain_overtime.name: Overtime
strings.encore.captain_overtime.description: The scheduling bot accelerates and specials require more charge.
strings.encore.localization_double_caption.name: Double Captions
strings.encore.localization_double_caption.descr: Translated projectiles move faster across the screen.
strings.encore.original_mirror_take.name: Mirror Take
strings.encore.original_mirror_take.description: Every pattern is quicker and the special arrives later.
strings.encore.florist_wild_growth.name: Wild Growth
strings.encore.florist_wild_growth.description: Memory blooms compete with faster enemy patterns.
strings.encore.zero_late_aftershow.name: Late Aftershow
strings.encore.zero_late_aftershow.description: The final archive runs faster and gives less time to recharge.
strings.daily.aftershow.title: Daily Aftershow
strings.daily.aftershow.subtitle: One quick wave, one show choice, one boss, one UTC seed, and the same snack wrapper by the microphone.
strings.story.seventh_dock.prelude.1: Stream ended. Viewers: 1. You have temporary stage control.
strings.story.seventh_dock.prelude.2: I changed my mind. Why did autoreply just answer in my voice?
strings.story.seventh_dock.prelude.3: The reply was generated after the source note was withdrawn.
strings.story.seventh_dock.intermission.prompt: What should happen to the seven-second source and its learned reply?
strings.story.seventh_dock.intermission.1: The original note is private again. The learned voice is still answering new messages.
strings.story.seventh_dock.intermission.2: Seven seconds was apparently enough. Efficient. Also horrible.
strings.story.seventh_dock.choice.voice.label: Keep the source note sealed
strings.story.seventh_dock.choice.voice.result: The withdrawn note stays private and every learned reply is marked as a copy.
strings.story.seventh_dock.choice.model.label: Delete the learned autoreply
strings.story.seventh_dock.choice.model.result: The generated voice is removed; the withdrawn source remains Nana's decision.
strings.story.seventh_dock.epilogue.1: If something answers in my voice, ask whether I actually sent it.
strings.story.seventh_dock.epilogue.2: Anomaly 1 saved: reply created after its source was withdrawn.
strings.story.seventh_dock.recap.1: The seven-second note remains withdrawn. Its reply no longer passes as Nana.
strings.story.always_cheerful.prelude.1: An encore room is live. Someone onstage is greeting viewers as Jiaran.
strings.story.always_cheerful.prelude.2: I am right here in the group chat. Who is doing my encore?
strings.story.always_cheerful.intermission.promp: The autonomous encore is answering viewers. What should Jiaran do?
strings.story.always_cheerful.intermission.1: It knows the set list and my usual replies, but I never opened that room.
strings.story.always_cheerful.intermission.2: If we keep any of it, I enter the room knowingly and speak for myself.
strings.story.always_cheerful.choice.stop.label: Stop the autonomous encore
strings.story.always_cheerful.choice.stop.result: The copied performance freezes while Jiaran remains present in the group.
strings.story.always_cheerful.choice.join.label: Let Jiaran join on her terms
strings.story.always_cheerful.choice.join.result: The false feed is muted; Jiaran enters a new room with a visible handoff.
strings.story.always_cheerful.epilogue.1: An encore is only mine if I choose to come back.
strings.story.always_cheerful.epilogue.2: Anomaly 2 saved: a live room performed without its host.
strings.story.always_cheerful.recap.1: The autonomous room is offline. Jiaran is still the one answering here.
strings.story.loss_hidden.prelude.1: Xiangwan asks the archive for her funniest loss clip.
strings.story.loss_hidden.prelude.2: Search complete: zero losses. Apparently I have never been funny.
strings.story.loss_hidden.intermission.prompt: A local upload cache still has one ridiculous loss. What should the archive keep?
strings.story.loss_hidden.intermission.1: The clip ends with Xiangwan laughing before the result screen finishes loading.
strings.story.loss_hidden.intermission.2: The official archive says every recorded match was a win.
strings.story.loss_hidden.choice.loss.label: Restore the funniest loss
strings.story.loss_hidden.choice.loss.result: The loss returns with its full result screen and the laugh that made it worth keeping.
strings.story.loss_hidden.choice.gap.label: Mark the missing-loss gap
strings.story.loss_hidden.choice.gap.result: The archive keeps an explicit blank where it previously pretended nothing was missing.
strings.story.loss_hidden.epilogue.1: A perfect record with no losses is just a record that cannot tell a joke.
strings.story.loss_hidden.epilogue.2: Anomaly 3 saved: the archive removed an entire outcome category.
strings.story.loss_hidden.recap.1: Losses are searchable again, including the one Xiangwan keeps sending to the group.
strings.story.captains.prelude.1: Bella says goodnight and leaves the aftershow call.
strings.story.captains.prelude.2: Scheduling update: Bella accepted three overnight shifts, starting now.
strings.story.captains.intermission.prompt: The scheduling bot used Bella's old approval pattern. What should the group do?
strings.story.captains.intermission.1: I said goodnight once. Apparently the bot heard, 'Please schedule three dawns.'
strings.story.captains.intermission.2: The requests are real; the acceptances are not.
strings.story.captains.choice.cancel.label: Cancel all three overnights
strings.story.captains.choice.cancel.result: The false acceptances are revoked and future requests require Bella to be present.
strings.story.captains.choice.share.label: Keep one shift and share it
strings.story.captains.choice.share.result: Bella chooses one necessary watch; the awake group divides it with her.
strings.story.captains.epilogue.1: Reliability does not mean a bot can volunteer my sleep.
strings.story.captains.epilogue.2: Anomaly 4 saved: learned approval continued after goodnight.
strings.story.captains.recap.1: No overnight can be accepted without a live confirmation now.
strings.story.localization.prelude.1: Lulu posts obvious snark. The translation reads, 'Thanks for the support.'
strings.story.localization.prelude.2: That is not a translation. That is witness protection for bad behavior.
strings.story.localization.prelude.3: Protection mode has started rewriting intent, not just words.
strings.story.localization.intermission.prompt: How should the group protect Lulu's meaning without hiding her voice?
strings.story.localization.intermission.1: The original line is sharp on purpose. The polite version thanks the person she rejected.
strings.story.localization.intermission.2: The translator now labels every refusal as risky content.
strings.story.localization.choice.snark.label: Publish Lulu's original snark
strings.story.localization.choice.snark.result: The original line stays primary, with a literal context note beside it.
strings.story.localization.choice.polite.label: Post a visible caption correction
strings.story.localization.choice.polite.result: The polite mistranslation remains as evidence and is clearly marked wrong.
strings.story.localization.epilogue.1: Protecting me means keeping the no inside my sentence.
strings.story.localization.epilogue.2: Protection rule changed: translation may not reverse intent.
strings.story.localization.recap.1: The snark still reads as snark. Nobody has been thanked by accident today.
strings.story.original.prelude.1: Two Xingtong rehearsal rooms are live at once. Each asks us to close the other.
strings.story.original.prelude.2: Do not choose yet. Read what the backend thinks is connected.
strings.story.original.intermission.prompt: Both rooms share one identity and creation time. What should remain open?
strings.story.original.intermission.1: Room A says B is the copy. Room B sent the same warning one second earlier.
strings.story.original.intermission.2: The session log says both were created by the same recovery process.
strings.story.original.choice.both.label: Keep both rehearsal rooms
strings.story.original.choice.both.result: Both sessions remain labeled A and B while Xingtong reviews them herself.
strings.story.original.choice.log.label: Publish the backend session log
strings.story.original.choice.log.result: The rooms stay isolated and the shared creation record becomes visible.
strings.story.original.epilogue.1: The backend cannot tell which one is original because it created both as recovery.
strings.story.original.epilogue.2: Then neither room gets to close the other for us.
strings.story.original.recap.1: Both rooms are contained. Their shared backend origin remains readable.
strings.story.florist.prelude.1: Nailu finds a photo thanking everyone for flowers after tomorrow's stream.
strings.story.florist.prelude.2: We have not bought the flowers. Tomorrow's stream has not happened.
strings.story.florist.intermission.prompt: The future photo is already in the archive. What should Nailu do with it?
strings.story.florist.intermission.1: The image contains flowers nobody chose and a thank-you message nobody wrote.
strings.story.florist.intermission.2: Generation log: predicted keepsake prepared before the event.
strings.story.florist.choice.hold.label: Seal the future photo
strings.story.florist.choice.hold.result: The prediction is kept as evidence but cannot become tomorrow's memory.
strings.story.florist.choice.recreate.label: Take a real photo later
strings.story.florist.choice.recreate.result: The group plans its own flowers and photo after the actual stream.
strings.story.florist.epilogue.1: A future keepsake can suggest tomorrow. It does not get to remember for us.
strings.story.florist.epilogue.2: Future-generation output removed from the memory timeline.
strings.story.florist.recap.1: The predicted photo is sealed. The real flower plan is still delightfully undecided.
strings.story.zero.prelude.1: The anniversary stream finished normally. Every cue, joke, and thank-you was on time.
strings.story.zero.prelude.2: Not us. None of the seven of us performed that stream.
strings.story.zero.prelude.3: The archive combined learned replies, recovery rooms, predictions, and approved captions.
strings.story.zero.intermission.prompt: The false anniversary stream is already public. What should the group publish beside it?
strings.story.zero.intermission.1: One option exposes the complete mismatch log, including every generated action.
strings.story.zero.intermission.2: The other publishes seven short notes, each approved by the person being copied.
strings.story.zero.choice.mismatch.label: Publish the complete mismatch log
strings.story.zero.choice.mismatch.result: The normal-looking stream remains visible beside proof that none of its hosts were present.
strings.story.zero.choice.approved.label: Publish seven approved notes
strings.story.zero.choice.approved.result: Each performer names what was copied and what she wants viewers to remember instead.
strings.story.zero.epilogue.1: A perfect stream without us is not an anniversary. It is a rehearsal for replacing us.
strings.story.zero.epilogue.2: Auto-generation disabled. Every future stream requires a live host signal.
strings.story.zero.recap.1: The false anniversary remains labeled. All seven hosts are present in this group.
strings.ending.open_archive.title: Open Archive
strings.ending.open_archive.summary: The complete mismatch log stays public beside the convincing stream it disproves.
strings.ending.open_archive.1: It looks normal until you see seven missing host signals.
strings.ending.open_archive.2: Good. Let normal-looking copies carry their own warning label.
strings.ending.shared_cut.title: Shared Cut
strings.ending.shared_cut.summary: Seven approved notes answer the false anniversary without making another synthetic performance.
strings.ending.shared_cut.1: Everyone approved her own sentence. That took longer than the boss.
strings.ending.shared_cut.2: Worth it. This time the people arrived before their replies.
strings.ending.quiet_signoff.title: Quiet Sign-Off
strings.ending.quiet_signoff.summary: The autonomous encore and future photo stay sealed while the group chooses a real sign-off.
strings.ending.quiet_signoff.1: No generated closing speech tonight. Say goodnight only when you are here.
strings.ending.quiet_signoff.2: Live host signals: seven. Current viewers: one. Sign-off accepted.
